Let a = ⁴√626 and b = ⁴√624, so a⁴ − b⁴ = 2.

Write x = 1/625. Then a = 5(1+x)^{1/4} and b = 5(1−x)^{1/4}.

Expanding (1+x)^{1/4} = 1 + x/4 − (3/32)x² + (7/128)x³ − …, the even-power terms cancel in the difference, leaving:

a − b = 5(x/2 + (7/64)x³ + …) = (5x/2)(1 + (7/32)x² + …)

Since 5x/2 = 1/250, this gives a − b = (1/250)(1 + 7/(32·625²) + …), and the correction is about 5.6×10⁻⁷.

Therefore 1/(a − b) ≈ 250(1 − 5.6×10⁻⁷) ≈ 249.99986, whose closest integer is 250.

ANSWER: 250
